name: dsh-session-top
description: ZCode-style session list for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: sessions float to the top of their list on any activity, a right-click session row offers Pin/Unpin, pinned sessions leave their workspace group for a flat 'Pinned' region at the top of the sidebar, and the pin state survives restarts. Dual-face (host + client) dsh plugin, zero core changes.

scripts.test: node --test test/core.test.js && node --test test/host-state.test.js && node test/bundle-smoke.mjs && node test/cordis-activation.mjs && node test/client-lifecycle.mjs && node test/pin-integration.mjs && node test/sidebar-dom.mjs && node test/shared-menu.mjs && node test/owner-menu-real.mjs
